tools.name: remove_duplicates
tools.description: Remove duplicate lines from a text list, or duplicate rows from CSV/TSV text such as rows copied from Excel or Google Sheets. Uses the same engine as removeduplicates.org and returns the cleaned text with counts. Stateless: the text is processed in memory for this call only and is never stored.

text.description: The list or table text: one item per line, or CSV/tab-separated rows. Up to 131072 UTF-8 bytes.

format.description: auto detects CSV/TSV tables; lines compares whole lines; table forces CSV/TSV parsing.

ignoreCase.description: Treat values such as Apple and apple as duplicates.

trim.description: Ignore surrounding spaces when comparing and return trimmed values.

removeEmpty.description: Drop blank lines or all-blank rows.

keep.description: Which occurrence of a duplicate survives.

order.description: preserve keeps the original order; sort returns a natural (numeric-aware) sort.

compare.description: Tables only: "row" compares entire rows; a zero-based column index or an array of indices compares only those columns.

header.description: Tables only: keep the first row as a header outside duplicate checks and counts.
